cohort: Calibrate on terminal states of the same 12 four-path training windows in sessions 5-8. Use the two actual prefixes per window with their native reach. Prior observations include a question whose correctly dated answer survived repair under one prefix and failed the retrieval veto under the other. Use all original questions, including ties, unlinked, unresolved and mixed cases. Evaluation uses actual measured terminal-pivot pairs of the existing 52-window sessions-9+ randomized panel. Pre-register which outcomes predate numeric freeze, leave the target dialogue out of fitting, and reserve independent full-history tests for separate evaluation.
outcome: The optional extra selection signal is the signed activity-minus-temporal F1 difference only for a linked full-reference recovery surviving the weaker-skill execution and retrieval probes. All other questions contribute zero. For a binary action at probability p, subtract the exact marginalized baseline: the temporal and activity advantages are -p*d and (1-p)*d. The neutral update is exact at d=0. Compare to the same model using raw paired F1 and to a state-independent model.
policy: Use the observed pre-write Qwen source and previous-memory halves of the deployed Controller state, never reader outputs, questions or gold annotations, for matching terminal states. For target s and donor t use exp((cos(source_s,source_t)+cos(memory_s,memory_t)-2)/0.25). Average donor signed outcomes with native prefix reach and the number of questions. Estimate the action-value difference from the centered advantages, then add clip(d/0.05,-2,2) to the target native logit (the binary KL-regularized update). A zero estimate keeps the native probability. Fit a rate-only logit shift matching the candidate's mean probability across donor states weighted by prefix reach; report realized held usage too. Treat state kernels as a declared hypothesis.
report: Disclose signed reward, competing and raw effects per question, the exact centering test, and the aggregate change in actual paired F1 at the changed probabilities. Keep incomplete retrospective pilot fits separate. Freeze the six leave-one-history fits on the full 12 windows before evaluating the subsequent terminal-pivot pairs; exclude any target with an already scored branch from strictly prospective results. For advancement seek +.02 over native and terminal, positive over rate-only and state-independent, across at least four dialogues. Report fixed actions and their relative F1, and zero-evidence fits. Both literature sources motivate the baseline and choice of outcome; this is a project-specific algorithm.
